verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some non-GUI surfaces: a single `zcode` entry point that runs a TUI, a web server, or passes arguments to an Agent CLI (zcode-gh-2, zcode-gh-3). There is also a plugin "page API" (zcode-gh-6) and remote invocation via chat apps (zcode-docs-3). None of this documents a general public API, let alone one with parity to the UI. missing for 10: a documented public API, evidence of UI-to-API feature parity, API reference docs, independent corroboration of programmatic control.
